epistemic_contract.lambda: normalized learned context support, not physical tone intensity
epistemic_contract.neural_readouts: normalized A/B unique-cell competition identifies attractor identity; signed A-minus-B evidence retains absolute retrieval strength
epistemic_contract.behavioral_readout: logistic envelope of signed retrieval evidence; inverse temperature is free/pilot, so neural evidence and digging discrimination are not identified
epistemic_contract.effect_size_warning: structural-seed Cohen dz is descriptive only and is not a sampling distribution or a power-analysis input
epistemic_contract.novel_context_C: no A/B-specific context field; only learned tone support acts in the A/B subspace
epistemic_contract.RAM: bare-A tag source, tagging efficiency, tag-test match, and light accessibility are separate operations
